# Binary data, slow consumer, credit recovery, and request/response half-close.
OPEN A 00ff => ok
TRANSFER A B => open(8,4,00ff)
EVENTS B 1 => incoming(00ff)
ACCEPT B 01 => ok
TRANSFER B A => accept(8,4,01)
EVENTS A 8 => opened(01)
EVENTS B 8 => opened(01)
SEND A 0001ff80 => accepted(4)
SEND A 02030405 => accepted(4)
SEND A 06 => would_block
TRANSFER A B => data(0,0001ff80),data(4,02030405)
EVENTS B 1 => data(0,0001ff80)
SEND A 06 => would_block
CONSUME B 4 => ok
TRANSFER B A => window(4)
EVENTS A 8 => writable
SEND A 06 => accepted(1)
FINISH A => ok
TRANSFER A B => data(8,06),fin(9)
STATE B => HalfClosedRemote
EVENTS B 8 => data(4,02030405),data(8,06),remote_finished
CONSUME B 9 => ok
SEND B aabb => accepted(2)
FINISH B => ok
STATE B => Draining
TRANSFER B A => window(9),data(0,aabb),fin(2)
STATE B => Closed
EVENTS A 8 => data(0,aabb),remote_finished
CONSUME A 2 => ok
STATE A => Closed
EVENTS A 8 => closed(Finished)
EVENTS B 8 => closed(Finished)
TRANSFER A B => -
EVENTS A 8 => -
